description: Two-column technical paper testing reading-order preservation vs horizontal line interleaving
ground_truth_text:
Empirical Evaluation of Document Understanding Architectures

1. Introduction & Motivation
Deep visual document understanding requires robust layout awareness.
Traditional single-shot OCR systems scan text lines strictly horizontally.
On multi-column layouts, horizontal scans interleave distinct columns.
This results in fragmented sentences and jumbled semantic meaning.
Enterprise search and LLM retrieval pipelines suffer catastrophic failure.
Therefore, layout-first segmentation is mandatory for multi-column text.

2. Two-Stage Vision Pipeline
Our two-stage approach decouples layout segmentation from OCR.
Stage 1 utilizes PP-DocLayoutV3 to detect column bounding boxes.
Stage 2 dispatches cropped semantic regions to a specialized SLM.
Text is parsed sequentially down column 1 before traversing column 2.
This preserves natural human reading order with 100% structural fidelity.
Extracted markdown cleanly mirrors original document intent and syntax.
